_doc: The three-stage funnel, one definition per ad. Each ad is a list of scenes; a scene owns a slice of the timeline and says which overlay components are on screen and what they say. render.js walks t from 0 to duration at brand.fps and screenshots each frame, so everything here is deterministic — no CSS transitions, no requestAnimationFrame (which never fires in a headless pane; see CLAUDE.md GOTCHAS).
_arc: All three are the Gallagher episode arc (NB-002) compressed to paid-social length. Scene 1 hook -> Scene 3 struggle -> Scenes 4-7 the visualization steps -> Scene 8 result + CTA. Stage 1 is the struggle, Stage 2 is the steps, Stage 3 is the result and the ask.

funnel-3-build._clipNote: masking and painting are the two clips to film on a live job - a crew taping a trim line, then a sprayer or roller laying the first coat. Real job-site footage is free, you have crews doing it today, and it is the one thing a competitor cannot fake. Film vertical, 8-12s each, then drop them in and re-render.
